kv10.1:1.1: upapattesiye pañcakkhandhe aniruddhe kiriyā pañcakkhandhā uppajjantī’ti.
kv10.1:1.3: dasannaṃ khandhānaṃ samodhānaṃ hoti, dasa khandhā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantī’ti.
kv10.1:1.5: dasannaṃ khandhānaṃ samodhānaṃ hoti, dasa khandhā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantī’ti.
kv10.1:1.6: āmantā. dvinnaṃ phassānaṃ …pe… dvinnaṃ cittānaṃ samodhānaṃ hotī’ti.
kv10.1:2.1: upapattesiye pañcakkhandhe aniruddhe kiriyā cattāro khandhā uppajjantī’ti.
kv10.1:2.3: navannaṃ khandhānaṃ samodhānaṃ hoti, nava khandhā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantī’ti.
kv10.1:2.5: navannaṃ khandhānaṃ samodhānaṃ hoti, nava khandhā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantī’ti.
kv10.1:2.6: āmantā. dvinnaṃ phassānaṃ …pe… dvinnaṃ cittānaṃ samodhānaṃ hotī’ti.
kv10.1:3.1: upapattesiye pañcakkhandhe aniruddhe kiriyā ñāṇaṃ uppajjantī’ti.
kv10.1:3.3: channaṃ khandhānaṃ samodhānaṃ hoti, cha khandhā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantī’ti.
kv10.1:3.5: channaṃ khandhānaṃ samodhānaṃ hoti, cha khandhā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantī’ti.
kv10.1:3.6: āmantā. dvinnaṃ phassānaṃ …pe… dvinnaṃ cittānaṃ samodhānaṃ hotī’ti.
kv10.1:4.3: mato maggaṃ bhāveti, kālaṃ kato maggā bhāvetī’ti.
